subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this umbrella issue remain open as the manual parent for core session-routing triage, or should maintainers close it after moving the remaining work to narrower issues?
